content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP® Certification in Columbus

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project-management experience. Review PMI's specific requirements for your background—typically a secondary degree plus years of directed project experience, or a four-year degree with fewer years required. Granite PM Academy's admissions team can verify your qualifications before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. Our instructor-led course covers the PMBOK® Guide framework, exam domains, and real-world application. Classes are scheduled to fit working professionals' calendars across all time zones, including evening and weekend cohorts.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the 35-hour course, submit your formal PMP application directly to PMI and pay the associated exam fee. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the application process and required documentation. Approval typically follows within days, allowing you to schedule your exam window.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the Exam
steps_items.text: Access Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice exams, study guides, and one-on-one coaching. Sit for the computer-based PMP exam at a Pearson VUE testing center. Our instructors remain available to address final questions before test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: Earn professional development units (PDUs) over a three-year renewal cycle to keep your credential active. PMI accepts PDUs from training, volunteer work, published articles, and conference attendance. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing learning opportunities to support your continuing education.
